As sete peças de um Jarvis: The seven parts of a Jarvis
Todo agente, do mais simples ao mais car: Every agent, from the simplest to the most expensive, has the same seven parts: a door, a heart, an identity, a brain, a memory, hands, and a vault. Knowing these parts helps you choose better, spend less, and avoid getting locked into one product. INTELECTO is our example: small on purpose, so you can read through it.

É por onde você conversa. No INTELECTO é: This is where you talk to it. In INTELECTO, that’s Telegram: one token and you’re ready, with no public internet address. The agent checks Telegram for new messages, splits replies longer than 4,000 characters, and shows “typing” while it thinks.
Recebe a mensagem, pensa, usa uma ferram: It receives your message, thinks, uses a tool if needed, checks the result, and thinks again until it replies with text. It has a brake: at most five tool rounds per message. After that, it has to reply.
Quatro arquivos simples na pasta workspa: Four simple files in the workspace folder: its soul, the rules, your profile, and the initial facts. The agent reads all four with every message. Change the text, change the assistant, without programming.
O modelo de IA. Na nuvem, o OpenRouter:: The AI model. In the cloud, OpenRouter: one key gives you access to more than a hundred models. On your computer, Ollama: no cost per message and nothing is sent outside your computer.
Guarda o que importa num banco SQLite na: It saves what matters in a SQLite database on your machine, with keyword search and no API cost. With each message, it finds what’s relevant and adds it to the context.
Sem ferramentas ele só conversa; com ela: Without tools, it only chats; with them, it gets things done. The core tools: read and write files, list folders, run commands, save to memory, and search memory. Each tool describes itself, and the model reads that description to decide whether to use it.
Chaves de API cifradas e presas à máquin: API keys encrypted and tied to the machine, a list of blocked commands, a 60-second timeout per command, and an audit log of everything it runs.
A resposta volta pelo canal até o seu ce: The reply travels back through the channel to your phone
As mesmas sete peças aparecem no INTELEC: The same seven pieces appear in INTELECTO, OpenClaw, Hermes, or a Jarvis you build yourself.
Você escreve no Telegram. O loop junta i: You write in Telegram. The loop brings together identity and memory, sends them to the model, runs the tool it requests within the vault’s limits, and sends the reply back through the same channel.
Três ideias que seguram as peças: Three ideas that hold the pieces together
O INTELECTO é um assistente pessoal para: INTELECTO is a personal assistant for one owner. It isn’t multiuser, doesn’t depend on the cloud, doesn’t need Docker, has no web dashboard, and isn’t a black box.
O plano prevê umas três mil linhas e set: The plan calls for about three thousand lines and seven dependencies: you can read it.
Consigo explicar o que acontece entre a: Can I explain what happens between my message and the response? If not, it’s a black box.
Um chatbot responde e esquece. Um agente: A chatbot responds and forgets. An agent thinks, acts with a tool, looks at the result, and thinks again.
Sem teto, um agente pode ficar girando e: Without a limit, an agent can keep spinning and spending without finishing. That’s why there’s a five-round brake.
No máximo 5 rodadas de ferramenta por me: At most 5 tool rounds per message; after that, respond with text.
Cada peça é definida por um contrato: o: Each part is defined by a contract: the channel has start, send, and stop; the provider receives the conversation and tools, then returns a response.
Quer WhatsApp no lugar do Telegram, ou O: Want WhatsApp instead of Telegram, or Ollama instead of OpenRouter? Use a different file with the same contract.
Nova ferramenta = arquivo novo no mesmo: New tool = new file using the same pattern. The registry finds it automatically, without changing the core.
O guia de funcionalidades organiza tudo: The feature guide organizes everything into eight areas: identity, security, channels, memory, automation, integrations, skills, and architecture.
Você não precisa de tudo. Agendamento e: You don’t need everything. Scheduling and web search, for example, are in the plan for the next phase.

Uma tela de texto: nome e jeito de falar: A text screen: a name and speaking style, three things it should do every week, three it should never do, and what it needs to remember about you. This is the source for the four files.
Quem ele é: nome, personalidade, tom de: Who it is: name, personality, tone of voice, and values. Write as if you were hiring a human assistant: what would you say in the interview?
O contrato de trabalho: consultar a memó: The work agreement: check memory before answering, ask when unsure, refuse dangerous commands. A written rule is more reliable than expecting the model to guess.
O seu perfil: profissão, rotina, como go: Your profile: profession, routine, how you like answers, and what language you use. It’s a living file: if your project changes, update it.
Os fatos que ele deve saber desde a prim: The facts it should know from the first conversation. What you share later goes into the memory bank (lesson 5).
A cada mensagem, o agente junta SOUL, AG: With each message, the agent adds SOUL, AGENTS, and USER to the start of the conversation. Editing a text file changes the assistant without touching code.
Responda cinco perguntas: nome, jeito de: Answer five questions: name, speaking style, three things it should do every week, three it should never do, and what it needs to remember about you.
Seja concreto. \"Cuide do meu e-mail\" é: Be specific. “Take care of my email” is vague; “every Monday, list the week’s three priorities based on what I’ve told you” is a request.
O arquivo cabe numa tela e outra pessoa: The file fits on one screen, and someone else could understand who your assistant is.
Um SOUL eficaz tem valores claros, tom e: An effective SOUL has clear values, a specific tone with an example, explicit limits, and a defined response style.
Um SOUL fraco diz \"seja útil e amigável: A weak SOUL says “be helpful and friendly,” contradicts itself (formal and casual at the same time), or is too long and loses focus.
Direto e conciso. Honesto: se não sabe,: Direct and concise. Honest: if you don’t know, say so. I want a partner who disagrees, not someone who just agrees.
Separe em SEMPRE e NUNCA. As regras do e: Separate into ALWAYS and NEVER. The example’s rules: check memory before answering, save what you learn about me, ask when unsure.
Para ferramentas: preferir comandos segu: For tools: prefer safe, read-only commands, and refuse destructive ones.
Nunca apagar arquivo sem a minha confirm: Never delete a file without my confirmation. Never put a password or key in a response.
No USER vai o que ele precisa saber de v: USER contains what it needs to know about you without asking every time: what you do, how you like answers, and what language you use.
No MEMORY, poucos fatos que valem desde: MEMORY contains a few facts that matter from day one. Keep it short: it learns what comes later by talking with you.
Prefere conselho prático a teoria. Valor: Prefers practical advice to theory. Values time: be concise. Speaks Portuguese (pt-BR).
